notes.content: Hello, I apologize for the slow response to some of the recent issues. I am tackling them all this week. We are preparing to test for console ports, and I had to upgrade the engine to support the accompanying framework for Game Maker. It appears to have slightly changed the way some things work with the current GML event order, and am updating all of it now, starting with this patch fixing the Kitora event issue and the cinematic crash.

*Fixed issue with Possession Meter not functioning properly.
*Fixed issue with some bosses getting softlocked in walls.
*Fixed issue that sometimes causes game to crash on minimize.

* XP values adjusted for mountain region
* Nerfs to castle boss HP
* Visual adjustment to 'Trapped' bar
* Adjustments to some objects not pausing properly
* Gambling achievement changed to discovering the dealer.

*Fixed issue causing White Spirit to deal incorrect damage on some abilities.
*Fixed issue allowing cannons to heal themselves.
*Fixed a critical issue with one of the secret bosses, causing a crash upon entering the arena.

*Adjusted Slime Pig projectiles to bounce as intended.
*Adjusted Swordfish to be un-knockable while charging.
*Changed Flight Master achievement to finding all 8 courses.
*Adjusted inhale hitbox to properly drop extraneous enemies when a swallow occurs.
*Adjusted downed enemy separation to not accelerate speed too high.
*Adjusted enemy swallowing scale to gradually revert rather than snapping.
Fixed a critical issue preventing an optional boss from being accessible, leading to crash.

notes.title: 1.0.1.5 Hotfix
notes.content: *Quick patch to repair a critical issue with the Spirit Ice Dragon enemy.

*Fixed an issue with the contest cinematic locking
*Fixed an issue with Killsha rematch bullets
*Added missing Tanuki NPC to Fox Hideout
*Added missing Spirit Bomb Dragon

Major patch stemming from many issues that arose from an engine version change at the end of last year. Some additional changes:

*Fixed issues with audio panning
*Added more altars to areas with large stretches in between
*Lowered health on White Spirit
*Changed some outdated graphical effects/UI elements
*Adjusted difficulty of spirit enemies, including the transformation speed
*Fixed some pixel issues on Munch

If crashes still remain that I missed when doing my full evaluation, I will fix them shortly.

notes.title: Temporary Rollback
notes.content:
I am going to roll back to the older build for awhile longer. From testing, there are more undiscovered problems than I thought. I do think I have covered most of them, but I will want to test everything privately all the way through. I am shifting to using the engine standalone rather than through steam, as it forces me to update it, leading to the issues that have cropped up.

I am anticipating on releasing the current build in about a week or less, which should be enough time for me to catch everything else that still remains.

notes.title: 1.0.0.10 Patchfix
notes.content:
Hello, I have been working with the save system for awhile and may have solved the strange issue for some users. 

There have been issues with the teleport scroll and not being able to access the unlocks for beating the game's true ending. These should be resolved now.

One of the other problems that many users have reported is the timeskip back when beating the final boss, sending your save back to the castle. This is intentional, but there was a small issue not 'changing' the game out of endgame. I have tried to set it up to where completing the game on the save will pull you back just before endgame for backtracking and exploration. If your save is in this camp, please post if this does not work. Thank you for all your support!

notes.title: Update 1.0.0.9
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38398973/5f662d9760c47dd82f1c6041b900d281ba61e461.jpg[/img]

Hello! Here is the new content for the 1.0.0.9 update. 

[b][u]Additions[/u][/b]
* New cover illustration is added. You can check it on the shop page and gallery menu in game.
* Gallery available in the main menu upon game completion. Our game-play tutorial comic and official illustrations are currently added, and more artwork may be added as well. 
* New game plus : You can now replay the game with keeping all upgrades. Game difficulty will be slightly harder on New game plus mode. Get missed achievements easily! 
* Additional 'Float' levels for the minigame have been added upon reaching the Spirit World. (Total of 8) With additional character skin. (Additional character skin unlocks after True ending)
* Certain NPCs will move to village after discovery for easy access. (i.e Kitora, Dice Table)
* Additional Language support. There may be some untranslated texts in new events of certain languages, we'll update those later.
* Additional restaurant NPC guests.
* Munch's maximum capacity have been increased on the oversize unlock event, with a few additional 'bigger' sprite images.
* Balance adjustment : Final boss's Health is lowered, added checkpoint on some tricky maps. and fixed a few areas that sporadically lead to soft-locks.

[u][b]Dev Notes[/b][/u]
* The jump height upgrade, while powerful, is intentional. We have removed the off-screen wall exploits, though.
* We are working on some of the performance issues in certain areas. Some of the systems need to be redone in a leaner way, especially since we plan to release on some consoles. Bug fixes are also still in the pipeline.
* In regards to the DLC, we pivoted early on to implement the Spirit Region toward the end of the game rather than the frog island. We do have other game ideas that may utilize that concept a little better.

Thank you so much for playing our game! If you have any trouble or bug while playing, feel free to report it on the discussion page!

notes.title: Patch v1.0.0.8
notes.content:
This is a larger patch. 

A new float game as been added to the beach resort, with more being made for each remaining zone.
New effect added to 'Black Hole' talent.

Bugfixes: 
*Screenshake setting will now save properly.
*VFX adjusted for Ancient Path entrance.
*Position is now saved for maps that have multiple altars.
*Teleport scrolls should now bring you to the sunset village if you have reached endgame. (In current saves, this will trigger upon being in any endgame map)
*Flamethrowers now pause properly.
*Boar Treasure Room food lowered as to not jump over 1 full size.
*Fixed an issue that caused chef enemies to become immortal if they are killed and healed by food at the same time.
*Ancient Path turrets now follow line of sight rules to engage.
*White Spirit now does 400 base damage on breath instead of 9999.
*Falling off the screen will now cancel any action you were doing and resets your state.
*Eating Contest no longer prematurely exits to Game Over screen.
*Well of the seal NPC now talks on approaching, not leaving.

For next update: 
*Updating text skip to be faster overall and usable in timed dialogue such as boss pre-battles.
*Control menu adjustments to allow more key swaps as well as controller button swaps.
*At least 1 more additional float level.

notes.title: Tribal Hunter 21-10-11 update
notes.content:
Patch note 2021-10-11

= new features
- Coin magnet ability from Kitami Plush
Now you can talk to those plush buddies from beach resort to get ability that helps collecting coins.

- Flight minigame with costume
Now your current explorer costume shows while you playing flight game.
Also I've added few more middle frame sprites so growth animation looks more smooth.

- More Language support - You can change language setting on menu

German
Spanish
Traditional Chinese
Simplified Chinese
Japanese
Russian

Thank you so much to all community translators!!! ^-^

(there can be some untranslated texts, we are working on it. Please report if you find any translation mistake.)

- Now you can pet the dog.
Good doggy needs petting. One in town, and another in mountain. (only available on size 1)

- Plant NPC
Not every Feeder plant is hostile, you can find friendly one that gives you game hint throughout the world!

- Non-popping animation
Got suggestion about Munch's popping animation in defeat can be disturbing to some people.
So we've added optional non-popping deflation animation when defeated. Turn on/off on option.

- Restaurant food preview
You can check out how food looks like before purchasing




 = balance

 - Certain bosses HP has been increased (King slime, Alpha wolf, Lord Darkdread, final boss)
Those boss fights ends way too quickly than we expected, now with higher HP those fights lasts longer and challenging enough.

- Health drink now heals 50% of total HP
now boss fight got harder, health drink is now much powerful and effective.
so you can use town shop more effectively and meaningful than before.

- Short delay after each combo
Currently Combo attack feels too powerful since you can just mash attack button without any penalty. Now it have some delay.
Looks more natural, and balanced.

- HP drain ability now heals 1/2/3/4/5 HP per level. (will be added with hotfix)
this ability was way too powerful before, it should be more balanced now.

- Laura boss fight enhanced




= Bug fixes

- Steam screenshot function

- saving option works properly

- fixed some misplaced tiles

- Changed acquisition text on ability menu to be easier to understand for 1 time unlocks

- Color fix of To-ri and Killsha because it was bit unintended from what I thought.

- And many minor bugs



= Upcomming changes

- Additional language support

- New zone - that will be placed at the end game zone, because it feels bit too short in end game. 
will be difficult and challenging to make more satisfying when you finish the game.

- There might be first Tribal Hunter goods! We will notice when it's ready :D



Thank you for playing Tribal Hunter! We are keep working on it to make game finished! :)

If you find any bug, please report on comment here or make post on forum.
